versions.changelog:
Initial release of the receive-feedback skill:

- Processes external code review feedback with thorough technical verification before applying fixes.
- Verifies each feedback item, classifying as valid (fixable) or invalid (with evidence); clarification requested if unparseable.
- Offers a strict single confirmation prompt to launch fixes for the full valid set, supporting user override to select specific fixes.
- Applies one fix per valid item—using parallel subagents if supported, or sequentially by the orchestrator otherwise, enforcing identical results.
- Tracks and documents all actions with clear evidence and response artifacts; no deferrals, bundling, or scope exceptions allowed.
